items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: I got very friendly with the bass player at that time, a great player, very famous, Cachao.

ctx.x: It’s implied and people are playing to it in their head, but no one is actually — like a clave can be played on a clave, right? But I’ve been fascinated by that music. I wish I knew more about it. © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-
I got very friendly with the bass player at that time, a great player, very famous, Cachao. You ever hear that name?
